# telnyx_porting_order_additional_document (Resource)

A document attached to a porting order in addition to its LOA and invoice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_document" "invoice" {
  url = "https://example.com/invoices/2026-10.pdf"
}

resource "telnyx_porting_order_additional_document" "invoice" {
  porting_order_id = telnyx_porting_order.office.id
  document_id      = telnyx_document.invoice.id
  document_type    = "invoice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document_id` (String) The id of the uploaded document.
- `document_type` (String) The type of document: loa, invoice, csr or other.
- `porting_order_id` (String) Identifies the associated porting order

### Read-Only

- `content_type` (String) The content type of the related document.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `filename` (String) The filename of the related document.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this additional document
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_porting_order_additional_document.example <porting_order_id>/<id>
```
